text:
customer_acme_ops: Hey support — saw a ~$120 spike on Friday's invoice vs our live dashboard. We only made ~3 API calls but invoice tokens look ~3000. Can you help investigate?

emily_support: Sorry about that — can you DM project id and any request ids you have? Also did you see any client or server errors/timeouts?

customer_acme_ops: project: acme-42. Request ids I captured client-side: req_3f2a, req_3f2b. We saw our client timeout after 10s and retried twice. No idempotency header used in our current client.

raj_sre: looping in infra to pull gateway + ingest traces. Can you paste the exact curl or SDK call you used (sanitized)?

customer_acme_ops: sure — here's a simplified repro we ran:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  --max-time 10 \\n  -d '{"model":"gpt-neox", "input":"test"}'
```
(note: no Idempotency-Key header)

lisa_billing: FYI our billing dedupe requires either an Idempotency-Key header or the same server-assigned request_id forwarded. If retries come in as distinct requests we bill tokens per ingest event.

raj_sre: infra found gateway logs for project acme-42 around 2023-08-11T17:03:21Z — upstream returned 502, edge policy retried twice (policy: retry-on-502). Because client didn't include an Idempotency-Key, each retry was forwarded as a new request. Snippet from gateway: 
```
[17:03:21] conn=0x7f2 upstream=10.1.1.12:502 id=ingest_aaa -> upstream_error(502)
[17:03:22] policy=retry-on-502 -> retrying request id=ingest_bbb
[17:03:23] forward -> id=ingest_ccc status=200 tokens=996
```
We see three ingestion events (ingest_aaa, ingest_bbb, ingest_ccc) each with ~996 tokens.

emily_support: That matches the customer's experience — 3 ingests x ~996 tokens -> ~2988 billed tokens while dashboard shows one successful response. We should treat the middle two as duplicates.

customer_acme_ops: ugh. Can you refund the duplicates? And what can we change on our side to avoid this?

lisa_billing: We'll open a billing case and propose a credit for duplicated tokens. Need confirm from infra on exact token delta, then finance will issue credit.

ingest_bot: ingest-bot: flagged 3 ingestion events for request group -> raw_tokens: [996, 996, 996], deduped_unique_tokens: 996, possible_duplicate_tokens: 1992.

raj_sre: Short-term mitigation: we can update gateway so that retries attach the original client-provided x-request-id (or Idempotency-Key) to retried attempts and the ingest pipeline will dedupe within a 30s window. Long-term: document required Idempotency-Key usage in SDK and enable optional automatic replays that preserve idempotency metadata. Rolling a patch to staging now, ETA ~48h.

emily_support: Thanks @raj_sre and @lisa_billing. @customer_acme_ops I'll DM you the billing case number and next steps for the credit. For immediate prevention: please add an Idempotency-Key header to your client requests; SDK update coming that adds it by default. :raised_hands:

customer_acme_ops: Thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. We'll patch our client and wait for the credit details. :thumbsup:
